data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 was GBP 0.139m. During 2024 there was a gross release on prior year reserves of GBP 0.099m (a c.71.2% release relative to opening gross claims outstanding), reported in the technical provisions movement as "Change in estimates of prior year provisions (99)". The report attributes the favourable movement to very low claims activity and strong underwriting performance on the 2023 year of account.
raw_causal_phrases: Claims activity has been very low during this calendar year with claims paid of GBP 0.1m contributing to net incurred losses being GBP 0.7m, well below expectations due to strong underwriting performance on the 2023 year of account.

data.data_quality_notes: Amounts extracted from technical provisions note and balance sheet (values presented in the accounts in GBP 000). Prior year movement is taken from the 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' line (gross). Claims development triangle was limited to 2024 and 2023 columns only, so triangle could not be used to compute PYD for earlier years. No specific named catastrophe events were identified in the report.
